task.claim:
Let N = P*C with gcd(P, C) = 1. Let C > 1 be not a perfect square and have
no divisor d with 1 < d < B. Let p_1, ..., p_r be distinct primes, each
dividing P to an odd exact power. Then every s, k with N = s*k^2 satisfy
s >= p_1 * ... * p_r * B. In particular the squarefree part of N is at
least (product of the odd-exponent known primes) * B.
